_doc: Random events. ratePerYear is the average number per year (most months stay quiet, as in real life). Effects: delayProb (added chance of delay), cancelShare (share of affected flights cancelled), demandMult, fuelMult (one-off jump), reputation (one-off change), scope: base | europe | all | region.

events.text: Storms at {base}: heavy delays and some cancellations today.
Thick fog at {base}: low-visibility procedures slow departures.
Air traffic control strike in Europe: flights cancelled for two days.
Oil markets jump: jet fuel up 25% overnight.
Oil prices slide: jet fuel 15% cheaper.
Economic downturn: travel demand down 10% for the coming months.
Tourism boom in {region}: demand up 15% there for three months.
A viral passenger video hurts {airline}'s reputation.
IT outage: check-in and crew systems down for a day.
Volcanic ash cloud closes much of European airspace.
